title: lock and await
cards/0/body: The compiler won't allow it: error CS1996. A lock belongs to a thread, and after await the method may resume on another one. The lock would then be released by a thread that never took it.
cards/1/q: Why can't you await inside a lock?
cards/1/options/0: lock is tied to a thread, and after await the method may resume on another thread
cards/1/explain: Monitor requires Exit to be called by the same thread that called Enter.
cards/2/body: SemaphoreSlim(1, 1) lets one caller in. Its WaitAsync waits without blocking the thread, and any thread can release it.
cards/3/explain: There's a Wait() too, but it blocks the thread.
cards/4/options/0: Otherwise an exception leaves the semaphore taken forever
cards/4/explain: A forgotten Release is a deadlock too, just a quiet one.
cards/5/options/0: Up to three callers can be inside at once
cards/5/explain: A counting semaphore limits concurrency, for example the number of simultaneous API requests.
cards/6/q: Which are true? Select all that apply.
cards/6/options/0: WaitAsync doesn't block the thread while waiting
cards/6/options/1: SemaphoreSlim isn't tied to a thread
cards/6/options/2: You can use lock around await
cards/6/options/3: You can skip Release: the GC will release it
cards/6/explain: Nobody will release the semaphore for you.
cards/7/pairs/0/1: A synchronous lock tied to a thread
cards/7/pairs/1/1: An async lock with a counter
